title: In-browser ooRexx/WASM controlled dummy application
summary: The browser demo uses upstream ooRexx WASM .js~fetch and .js~page~document, .js~handler DOM event links, a 3-chat dummy app, a lease token, and localStorage-projected dummy transcript. It does not access the real ChatGPT UI.
invariants: Use Josef Maria Blasco upstream matching WASM assets and cross-origin isolation headers.
No arbitrary DOM executor or selector from event payloads; only predefined target ID in toy app.
Native ooRexx process owns the watch independently of browser lifetime.
Multi-tab lease expiry and localStorage alone do not establish durable external side-effect idempotence.

provenance.claim: Development source candidate; qualification state explicitly bounded.
